description:
Use global TikTok 47.0.3 with Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer.

## What's new

* Feed screen adds **Hide the search bar below videos**. It removes the suggested-search strip above the bottom tabs and gives that space back to video details and side controls. Top search and comment suggestions keep their own settings.
* Feed screen also adds independent switches for the **Full screen button** and **location labels**, including multi-place badges.
* Feed filter, under Ads, adds **Filter location-tagged videos**. Hiding a location badge and filtering its video are separate choices. A location badge doesn't prove a video is a paid ad.
* Comment tools adds **Easier comment likes**, which extends the heart's touch area into nearby empty space without enlarging comment rows. Scrolling and holding won't trigger a like.

These options are off by default. Restart TikTok after changing them.

## Checked before release

All 1,562 runtime tests and 265 patch tests passed locally, along with both Android lint checks. All 91 patches applied to 47.0.3 and the four retained older fixtures. The older builds are compatibility checks, not the recommended download.

On the S22, the same bottom-search video was checked with the switch off, on, off and on again after restarts. The strip's 101-pixel reservation disappeared completely, with the caption and side controls using its space. The bottom tabs and seek bar stayed fixed. The exact release bundle was also rebuilt into a matching-key APK and checked on that phone. Earlier S22 checks cover location badge hiding, native feed filtering and the larger comment-heart target. The S25 wasn't updated because its signing key differs from the local test key.

The Morphe source repair remains included. Refresh the existing Hushfeed source if you previously saw "The remote metadata file is unavailable". You don't need to clear Manager data or change its signing key.

The download is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep your existing signing key when updating.
